Abandonment_Loss_Worry.definition: A persistent worry that important people will leave, lose interest, or stop caring.
anchor_items: I'm afraid that I will lose people's love.
I often worry that people will not want to stay with me.
I often worry that people don't really love me.
When my loved ones are out of sight, I worry that they might become interested in others.
I often worry about others leaving me.
I often worry about being abandoned.
key_phrases: \bwhat if (he|she|they|you|my (partner|boyfriend|girlfriend|husband|wife|friend|mom|dad|family))('s| is| are)? (leav\w*|gone|not coming back|done with me)\b
\bare you going to (leave|disappear|stop responding|stop talking to me)\b
prototype_sentences: I get anxious thinking someone I care about might stop loving me.
I worry a lot that people close to me won't want to stick around.
When someone I love is away, I start worrying they're losing interest.
I have a persistent fear of being left by people I care about.

Relational_Imbalance.definition: An imbalance of care, feelings, or desire for closeness in a relationship, where the person feels they are giving more than they are receiving.
anchor_items: I worry that others won't care about me as much as I care about them.
I often wish that others' feelings for me were as strong as my feelings for them.
When I show my feelings for others, I'm afraid they will not feel the same about me.
I find that others don't want to get as close as I would like.
key_phrases: \bgive so much and get (so little|nothing|barely anything) back\b
\b(open up|show (my )?feelings|express how (I|i) feel)\b.{0,60}\b(scared|afraid|worried|nervous)\b.{0,40}\b(reciprocat\w*|feel the same|won'?t feel the same)\b
prototype_sentences: I feel like I care about this relationship more than the other person does.
It seems like I always want more closeness than they're willing to give.
I wish the emotional investment between us felt more equal.
When I open up, I'm not sure they feel the same way back.

Relationship_Self_Doubt.definition: Doubt about one's own worth in relationships; comparing oneself to other people and feeling inferior.
anchor_items: I worry that I won't measure up to other people.
key_phrases: \bwhy (am I|do I feel like I'?m) never (good enough|the first choice|someone'?s first pick)\b
prototype_sentences: Being around certain people makes me question my own worth.
I worry that I don't measure up compared to other people.
I sometimes feel like I'm not enough for the people I'm close to.
I doubt myself a lot when I think about how others see me.

Fear_of_Being_Known.definition: Wants closeness but fears that showing one's true self to others will lead to rejection.
anchor_items: My desire to be very close sometimes scares people away.
I'm afraid that once someone gets to know me, they won't like who I really am.
key_phrases: \bif (they|he|she|you|anyone|someone|somebody) (really |truly )?(knew|got to know me|found out who I (really |truly )?am)\b.{0,60}\b(leave|leav\w*|reject\w*|walk away|wouldn'?t (like|want|stay|love me)|didn'?t like what they found)\b
\bafraid (you'?d|you would|you'?ll|they'?d|they would) (judge|think less of|see me differently|reject me)\b
\bdon'?t let people (get too close|see the real me|in)\b
\bhard to (open up|let people in|be vulnerable) with (him|her|them|you|anyone)\b
\bwhat if (they|he|she|you|someone|somebody) (saw|see) the real me and (left|leave|don'?t like it)\b
prototype_sentences: I worry that if people really got to know me, they wouldn't like me.
Sometimes wanting closeness this much ends up pushing people away.
I hold back from showing my real self to people I'm close to.
I'm afraid of what happens once someone truly sees who I am.

Anger_at_Unmet_Needs.definition: Frustration and anger when emotional support is withheld, including escalating behavior to elicit a response.
anchor_items: It makes me mad that I don't get the affection and support I need from others.
Others only seem to notice me when I'm angry.
key_phrases: \bonly (notice(s)?|pay attention to) me when I('m| get) (angry|upset|mad|yelling)\b
\bwhy do I (always )?have to (be the one to|beg to) get (attention|noticed|a response)\b
prototype_sentences: It frustrates me that I don't get the support I need from people around me.
I feel like people only pay attention to me once I get upset.
I get angry when my needs go unnoticed by people I'm close to.
I resent having to ask for basic care and attention.
